description: SOC alert-triage source playbook. Ingests typed alert payloads from at least two source shapes (push from detection pipeline, pull from a shared alert store), enriches with telemetry context, suppresses already-seen or known-benign hits inside a configurable window, applies a deterministic prioritisation policy (free-text fields may be routed through a DSPy module, the priority decision itself stays in code), and routes the case onto a response branch keyed on the disposition. SKELETON: action bodies are stubs; the workflow graph, join keys, and metric/control references are the contract this source artifact commits to.
name: Alert triage

__alert_id__.description: Identifier of the inbound alert in the operator's alert store. Carried opaquely; the source shape is asserted in __alert_source_shape__.

__alert_source_shape__.description: One of: push_detection_pipeline, pull_alert_store. Used to select the normalization path in the ingest step.

__benign_or_seen__.description: Set by the suppression check: true when the alert matches a known- benign rule or an already-seen case fingerprint inside the configured suppression window.

__priority__.description: Deterministic priority assigned by the prioritisation policy. One of: p1_severe, p2_high, p3_routine, p4_informational.

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Normalise the inbound alert into the SecOps-NG alert envelope. Two source shapes are required by the roadmap acceptance criteria (push from detection pipeline, pull from a shared alert store); the dispatcher branches on __alert_source_shape__. Body of the normalization rules lands in the CORE-INGEST card.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: ingest typed alert payload

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Pull adjacent telemetry for the entities named in the alert (subject identity, source/destination, asset) so the prioritisation policy and suppression check have evidence beyond the alert envelope itself. Stubbed; the enrichment fan-out lands in CORE-ENRICH.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: enrich with telemetry context

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Link this alert onto the existing case (or onto the benign-rule record), close it without paging, and account the suppression against the false-positive-rate KPI and (when the suppression covers a re-fire of a previously closed case) the recurring-incident correlator.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: suppress and close

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Apply the operator's prioritisation policy. The policy itself is expressed as code (the roadmap pins this: deterministic prioritisation, DSPy used only for free-text fields like the analyst summary). Output is __priority__ ∈ {p1_severe, p2_high, p3_routine, p4_informational}.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: classify and prioritise (deterministic policy)

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Page the on-call responder, open the incident case, stamp the timeline-start signal, and hand off to the incident management playbook. Records against the MTTR-critical clock and the regulator-notification-overrun KRI window.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: response: p1 severe — page and escalate

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Queue the case to the primary analyst queue with the enriched evidence packet, no page. Records against the MTTR clock and the handoff-brief delivery SLA.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: response: p2 high — queue for primary analyst

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Append to the review queue for batched analyst attention; no SLA clock beyond the routine review-completion SLA.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: response: p3 routine — queue for review

action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: SKELETON. Record the alert for telemetry-coverage accounting and close without further action. Feeds the false-positive-rate denominator and the detection-coverage view.
action--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: response: p4 informational — log and close

if-condition--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00.description: Suppression branch. on_success: matches a known-benign rule or an already-seen case fingerprint inside the window; suppress and close. on_failure: proceed to prioritisation.
if-condition--a1e47431-0000-4000-8000-00.name: already-seen or known-benign?

switch-condition--a1e47431-0000-4000-800.description: Route to the response branch keyed on the deterministic priority. Each branch is a single response-routing action that hands off to the appropriate downstream playbook or owner queue. Bodies of downstream playbooks are out of scope here.
switch-condition--a1e47431-0000-4000-800.name: route on priority
